title: Fix the Off-by-One and Infinite while Loop
prompt: The starter code is supposed to sum integers 1 through 5 (expected total = 15) using a while loop, but n never increments and the condition misses 5. Fix the loop so total equals 15.
hints: Increment n += 1 inside the loop body.
Make sure total += n runs before n += 1.
solution:
n = 1
total = 0
while n <= 5:
    total += n
    n += 1
explanation: Using <= 5 includes 5, and n += 1 ensures the while condition eventually becomes False.
brokenCode:
n = 1
total = 0
while n < 5:
    total += n
    # missing increment!
bugDescription: n was never incremented (infinite loop) and < 5 excluded 5.

questions.question: When does the else clause of a for ... else or while ... else loop execute?
options: When the loop finishes normally without hitting break
Never; it is a syntax error
questions.explanation: A loop's else block runs after the loop finishes normally (no break).

title: range(start, stop) upper bound
back: No. `range(start, stop)` is half-open: it includes `start` and stops **before** `stop` (`1` through `9`).

title: break vs continue vs loop-else
solution: break exits; continue skips one iteration; else runs if no break occurred.
back: `break` exits the loop; `continue` skips to the next iteration; `else` runs only if the loop finished without `break`.
